multi_entity_note: ADMA BioManufacturing, Sanofi Pasteur and predecessor BPC, plus several related agreements and an instalment payment schedule.
processing_note: Such payments shall be made in accordance with Section 3.4 of the Agreement; provided, however, that the initial payment described in Section 5(a) above shall be due no later than December 31,2017.

contract.document_name.rationale: The title is "Amendment #3 to the Manufacturing Agreement"; "Amendment #3" alone is its short form, and the other names refer to the underlying agreement or Amendment #2.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The amendment is made as of December 21, 2017; ADMA signed on 12-21-2017 and Sanofi Pasteur on 22 Dec. 2017.

contract.effective_date.rationale: The amendment is "made effective as of December 21, 2017" (the Amendment Effective Date); the other dates belong to earlier agreements, payments or signatures.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The amendment states no expiry date for the agreement; Q3/Q4 2019 are supply-period ends and the other dates are payments or earlier agreements.

contract.governing_law.rationale: The amendment has no governing-law clause; Delaware, Florida and France appear only in party descriptions and addresses.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: No renewal term is stated; 60 days is the deadline for amending the Quality Agreement.

contract.notice_period.rationale: No notice period for preventing renewal is stated; 60 days is the deadline for amending the Quality Agreement.
